name: Fuzhou Changle International Airport
before:
Fujian's provincial capital airport, on the shore of the Taiwan Strait at Changle, about 50 km east of central Fuzhou. It is a major hub for Fuzhou Airlines and XiamenAir, and in 2025 it handled 16.117 million passengers across 112,326 movements, both up on the year.

The transfer is the thing to plan for, because 50 km is a long way. Several expressways reach the airport directly, shuttle buses run from 4.30 in the morning until 10.30 at night, and since September 2025 the Binhai Express has connected Fuzhou Railway Station with the airport.

The weather is worth a word. The site has the sea on three sides with hills inland, and the local pattern is low cloud, plenty of rain and a lot of wind, averaging 4.5 metres a second across the year. Spring brings long rainy spells and summer brings typhoons and heavy downpours. Winter is the settled, sunny season.

The airport opened in June 1997.
after:
Fujian's provincial capital airport, at Changle, about 50 km east of central Fuzhou. It is a hub for XiamenAir, and in 2025 it handled 16.117 million passengers across 112,326 movements, both up on the year.

The transfer is the thing to plan for, because 50 km is a long way. Airport buses run into the city and to surrounding areas, and since September 2025 the Binhai Express has connected Fuzhou Railway Station with the airport.

The weather is worth a word, as summer brings typhoons.

It opened in June 1997.

Its own site builds its pages by script: the company profile came back empty to a plain fetch and to the browser, and so did the contact page (three attempts). claims.claim: new Terminal 2 open since 16 September 2026, with all international flights
claims.note: Found while checking the airlines and buses: Terminal 2 opened at 05:00 on 16 September 2026 and took all international, Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan flights, plus the domestic flights of XiamenAir, Hebei Airlines and Jiangxi Air (Fujian provincial TV news, 1 Sep 2026; Wikipedia). The operator's bus page already gives Terminal 2's bus stop. This is exactly what a UK agent needs, since any international arrival now uses Terminal 2.
